title: Claude launches through the PowerShell tool get no launch observation, silently: the host's pushd hint doesn't name the Bash tool, and the run settles nowhere
outcome: A Claude session that launches a registered test-launcher run through its PowerShell tool learns at launch time that the run will not be observed or settled, and the host's source-root and test-placement hints tell it to use the Bash tool with the one-call pushd form. A registered run that can never be associated with a launch row is not left in "received" with no explanation.
acceptance: The host's source-root or test-placement hint that prescribes the `pushd "DIR" && <test>` form names the Bash tool explicitly for Claude sessions, and says that a launch through the PowerShell tool is not observed.

When a registered launcher run is admitted for a Claude session whose launch arrives through a tool the host does not observe (for example the PowerShell tool), the registration or wait reports that typed reason at launch or wait time, instead of an unexplained 'received, no launch observation carries it'. If that is only detectable at settlement, the terminal reason names the unobserved tool route.

Behavioural tests cover the hint text's presence by observable host output (not by reading repository Markdown) and the typed reason for an unobserved-tool registration. No text-pinning of repository docs. The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher finding and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
